blocks.text: In Helotes, TX, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air is your go-to source for expert HVAC and plumbing solutions. From keeping your home cool in summer to warming it up in winter, our experienced team of technicians and plumbers has you covered. We’re prepared to repair, install and maintain a variety of HVAC and plumbing systems. The customer experience comes first, and we pride ourselves on offering dependable service year-round. When you call us for HVAC or plumbing assistance, your comfort is never a compromise.

When the sun beats down, the last thing you want is an AC that can’t keep up. Winters may be milder, but even a chilly night feels long without reliable heat. That’s where Rosenberg Plumbing & Air comes in. Our NATE-certified technicians know how to keep your system running at its best, whether that means a seasonal tune-up, a tricky repair or a full system replacement. As a Lennox Premier Dealer, we offer the best in HVAC equipment when it’s time to replace your old system.

For homeowners who want peace of mind year-round, our Comfort Club membership makes maintenance simple. Members enjoy priority scheduling, reminders for service visits and discounted repairs. Not only does regular care extend the life of your HVAC equipment, it can also improve energy efficiency and save you money in the long run. Our team makes sure your home stays comfortable through every season.

Just like with heating and cooling, plumbing systems need routine attention to stay reliable. That’s why we offer a maintenance program with a range of perks for members to enjoy. Regular inspections and service help protect your home, save water, and extend the life of your fixtures and equipment. And when unexpected trouble strikes, our team is ready with emergency plumbing support to get things back to normal fast. Whether it’s preventive care or urgent repair, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air is the local team Helotes residents trust to keep their plumbing running smoothly.
